caption:
Bombay High Court refuses Tata Trusts a stay on Tata Sons board meeting

The board meets on Monday, and any outcome is subject to the court's final ruling. The Bombay High Court ruled on Friday on interim relief sought by Sir Dorabji Tata Trust and RD Tata Trust. The casting vote at Tata Sons remains intact.

Reported by Mint.
